name: Hive 1.7.0
notes: Automated setup + relay-managed teams. Settings → Models gains 'Detect my setup' (one click wires every provider that already answers — env/saved API keys, a local Ollama, the Claude Code/Codex CLIs), a Test button that validates a provider key at entry, one-step 'Add model', and portable hive.toml export/import so an architect can version-control a setup and stamp it across a team. Onboarding now verifies an API agent actually responds before finishing. The CLI gains 'hive setup' (headless detect) and 'hive config export/import'. Teams can now be managed on the relay: an owner claims a workspace, assigns roles, and issues revocable/expiring invite codes; the People pane manages members + invites, and a membership-enabled relay enforces who may read/write while staying end-to-end encrypted (it never sees keys or content).
